card.name: Unit words ending a measure
card.fires_on: The final piece of a unit or quantity word right after a number, most often the L in 10^9/L blood counts. Also seen in currency and amount words like riel, applicatorful and suns.

modes.label: Per-litre in blood counts
modes.description: The L after a slash in cell count thresholds such as platelets or ANC.
modes.example: than 50 x 10 9 /<<L>> Continue hold Table 5: Myel

modes.label: Other amount words
modes.description: The end of a unit or currency word after a number or quantity.
modes.example: The usual dose is one applicator<<ful>> once or twice daily for two or three

card.writes: It suppresses unit and currency words like litre, dollars and pounds, so it discourages another unit from following.
card.plain: It marks the end of a unit already written after a number, such as the L in 10^9/L.
